data.rule: Commit-hook git reads run in the tree being committed (the hook's cwd toplevel, if it belongs to this repository), inheriting GIT_INDEX_FILE; never git -C <primary>. When simulating a hook, set every variable git exports: a linked worktree's hook gets GIT_DIR as well as GIT_INDEX_FILE, and GIT_DIR alone had been masking this bug in real commits.
data.title: A git hook's reads must not depend on which GIT_* variables the runner kept: run them in the committing tree

data.decision: check_item_trailer accepts a trailer whose key is in item_trailer_keys OR trailer_waivers. A waiver key's value must be one of its words wherever it appears; every other accepted key's value must be a queue item id (any state but removed). Every accepted trailer present must be valid; at least one must be present. Keys match case-insensitively, like git's %(trailers:key=...).

data.rule: Collect all findings from one concurrent rubber_duck+critic round, fix or refute them together, then re-run both once; do not commit between a round's start and its result.
